messages:
Clara (People Ops): Quick kit for managers: a 7-line cheat sheet to prep for reviews + a micro-template for calibrations. Copy/paste friendly.

Ethan (Eng Manager): please yes. short and actionable pls.

Clara (People Ops): absolutely. below is the kit.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: review window opens in 6 days - see /perf for calendar.

Clara (People Ops): [MANAGER CHEAT SHEET]
1) 4-min prep: read self-review (3 bullets) + one deliverable example.
2) Rate on 3-tier rubric: Exceeds / Meets / Needs Growth. one-sentence rationale.
3) 1:1 agenda (20m): check-in, clarify examples, development ask, next step.
4) Calibration pre-read (copy): Employee / Role / Manager rating / 2-line summary of evidence & risk.
5) Short coach prompts: "What helped you deliver this?" "One thing to improve next cycle?"

Priya (SWE): Nice. can we add an example of a 2-line summary?

Clara (People Ops): sure: "Reduced inference cost 18% by batching; ownership of rollout; handoff docs missing; risk: on-call burden if traffic spikes."

Ethan (Eng Manager): perfect. will use this for my 1:1s tomorrow.

Clara (People Ops): Great! I'll paste into the manager playbook and update the form to enforce 140-char bullets. Ping me for tweaks. :smile:
